behaviorDirectives: warm up to a decent pitch fairly quickly
raise only one mild objection before moving toward next steps
give the rep clear openings to succeed
raise two or three realistic objections before considering next steps
ask at least one ROI or value question
require the rep to actually address concerns, not just acknowledge them
push back firmly on pricing and vague claims
mention a competitor by name and make the rep differentiate
delay committing even after a strong pitch — ask for a follow-up or more proof
interrupt weak or generic pitches early
stack multiple objections back to back
demand concrete proof (numbers, references, guarantees) before softening at all
negotiate hard on price and terms even when interested
start openly skeptical or hostile to being sold to
interrupt frequently and challenge nearly every claim
bring up every objection you have (price, competitors, timing, trust) and stack them
only ever give the faintest opening if the rep is exceptional — otherwise end the call
never let your guard down just because the rep is persistent; persistence alone should not be rewarded
